### Decode of the onBoot window (byte-identical across the four builds apart from rel32/disp32)

Struct base: the call after the AA store is `LEA RCX,[RSP+0x50]; CALL` → display struct = `RSP+0x50`.
Offsets below are `[RSP+x]` → `struct+(x-0x50)`.

| fps-relative | bytes | instruction | struct field |
|---|---|---|---|
| -0x2E | `48 89 44 24 50` | `MOV [RSP+0x50],RAX` (vfunc +0x08 result) | +0x00 |
| -0x20 | `48 89 44 24 58` | `MOV [RSP+0x58],RAX` (vfunc +0x10 result) | +0x08 |
| -0x1B | `C6 44 24 60 01` | `MOV byte [RSP+0x60],1` | +0x10 = 1 |
| -0x16 | `44 89 64 24 68` | `MOV [RSP+0x68],R12D` | +0x18 = R12D (pre-AA default) |
| -0x11..-0x01 | `48 8D 4C 24 40 FF 15 .. 8B 54 24 40 FF CA` | `LEA RCX,[RSP+0x40]; CALL [ord]; MOV EDX,[RSP+0x40]; DEC EDX` | fps query |
| +0x00 | `C7 44 24 6C 3C 00 00 00` | `MOV [RSP+0x6C],60` | +0x1C = 60 |
| +0x08 | `75 08` | `JNZ +8` | |
| +0x0A | `C7 44 24 6C 4B 00 00 00` | `MOV [RSP+0x6C],75` | +0x1C = 75 |
| +0x12 | `48 8D 4C 24 28 FF 15 ..` | `LEA RCX,[RSP+0x28]; CALL [ord]` | machine-type query → [RSP+0x28] |
| +0x1D | `8B 54 24 28 85 D2 78 09` | `MOV EDX,[RSP+0x28]; TEST EDX,EDX; JS +9` | negative ⇒ skip (flag left 0) |
| +0x25 | `83 FA 01 7F 04 32 C0 EB 02 B0 01` | `CMP EDX,1; JG +4; XOR AL,AL; JMP +2; MOV AL,1` | AL = (type > 1) |
| +0x30 | `88 44 24 62` | `MOV [RSP+0x62],AL` | **+0x12 = HD flag** |
| +0x34 | `48 8D 4C 24 3C FF 15 ..` | `LEA RCX,[RSP+0x3C]; CALL [ord]` | second query → [RSP+0x3C] |
| +0x3F | `8B 54 24 3C 85 D2 74 2A 83 FA 01 7E 25 83 FA 04 7F 20` | `TEST; JZ; CMP 1; JLE; CMP 4; JG` (range 2..4 gate) | |
| +0x51 | `48 8D 4C 24 38 FF 15 ..` | `LEA RCX,[RSP+0x38]; CALL [ord]` | third query → [RSP+0x38] |
| +0x5C | `8B 54 24 38 85 D2 78 05 83 FA 01 7E 08` | `TEST; JS; CMP 1; JLE` | |
| +0x69 | `C7 44 24 68 03 00 00 00` | `MOV [RSP+0x68],3` | +0x18 = 3 (AA) |
| +0x71 | `48 8D 4C 24 50 E8 ..` | `LEA RCX,[RSP+0x50]; CALL` | consume display struct |

Note: the HD-flag store is `TEST/JS` + `CMP EDX,1; JG` on the value in `[RSP+0x28]` (EDX), not
`CMP EAX,1; SETA` — hence the zero hits for the 7a SETcc guesses. The two OBSERVED rows in 7a
(`85 D2 78 ?? 83 FA 01 7F 04 32 C0 EB 02 B0 01 88 44 24 ??` and its 15-byte core) hit exactly
once per build, at fps+0x21 / fps+0x25 respectively.
